skill_name: Based on the article, explain the importance of machine learning in healthcare.
workflow: The use of machine learning has become essential in healthcare due to its ability to quickly process large amounts of data, draw meaningful insights, and identify trends or patterns in data that may be difficult to notice by humans. With machine learning, healthcare professionals are now able to make better, more informed decisions with fewer errors.
